families.source_entry: **Pair-individual support hierarchy, with fixed worlds.** This is NOT the root5 family whose individual action is trivial. Here E=J×{0,1}, G=(Z/2Z)^J acts NONTRIVIALLY by independent individual-pair flips, W has TRIVIAL action, and supports contain fewer than a fixed infinite regular κ pair indices. The model has BP and a full e-free hierarchy. All-type Intensional Choice holds exactly when |W|<κ; all e-free IC instances hold for every W; Relational Choice fails for every nonempty W. For κ=ω and J=W=ω, Ret_t holds while IC_e fails. These verdicts form one distinct model family, not a second count of root's world-action/Dedekind/support classification. Route: structural-mixing-models.md §§2–3, 15.2. The separate pair-WORLD construction with trivial individuals is left to the root tally and does not add another count here.
